# U.S. Market Regime MCP

> Open-source MCP (stdio) server that returns the published end-of-day U.S. market regime (GREEN / YELLOW / RED) with QQQ, VIX and distribution-day metrics. Educational market context only; not investment advice.

## Tools
- [get_market_regime](https://github.com/alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp#tools): latest regime, metrics, as_of date and freshness
- [explain_regime_model](https://github.com/alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp#tools): meaning of each state and metric

## Links
- [Source code](https://github.com/alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp)
